en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a brick pedestrian bridge or walkway leading toward two square brick pillars with decorative caps, surrounded by dense trees. At the far end of the bridge stand a couple of people near a gate, with a hint of water or open space visible beyond the trees. The image has a white border with printed captions at the bottom indicating the location and subject.
